new_value: Fixed spec/12-apps.md §18.9 (Dead Drop rate limiting): removed the unimplementable IID keying branch. Since POSTs MUST be OSCORE-protected (:1692, unprotected -> 4.01), the IID branch was dead text for the write path. Key is now the sender's OSCORE identity (sender/recipient ID pair for pairwise, (group context, Sender ID) for group), matching the nj4k confessions fix for sibling consistency; MUST NOT key on extracted IID (routable /128 is upstream AddrForKey, embeds no IID per 04-network.md §6.2). No unprotected-fallback key needed since writes require OSCORE. Self-reviewed (small prose fix mirroring the 3-round-reviewed nj4k; opencode reviewer API intermittently timing out): correct/dead-text, no auth downgrade, group context covered.
